_about: Apple M4 Mac 案例的冻结证据包。信息截至 2024-09-30；两条资料均可核实在截点前发布。

evidence.title: Apple Expected To Release M4 MacBook Pro Models In October 2024
evidence.excerpt: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman has reported, referring to the following M4 Macs… J604: a new low-end 14-inch MacBook Pro with the M4 chip.
evidence.claim: 截至日前已有报道预期 Apple 在 2024 年 10 月更新 M4 Mac 产品线。

evidence.title: Macs to Get AI-Focused M4 Chips Starting in Late 2024
evidence.excerpt: Apple will begin updating its Mac lineup with M4 chips in late 2024, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman.
evidence.claim: 2024-04 的报道已把首批 M4 Mac 更新指向 2024 年末，为 10 月窗口提供事前依据。
